items.title: Journey 26: Socket disconnect indicator and room rejoin (waived — mechanism retired, replaced by the SSE reconnect journey)
acceptance: GIVEN an open conversation with a live socket
WHEN the socket disconnects and reconnects
THEN the sidebar indicator reflects each state
AND rooms are rejoined so live updates resume

verify.testId: J26.1: the notification SSE stream is mounted, and a dropped connection is re-opened automatically

waiver.reason: The acceptance below is socket.io-specific and its mechanism was retired for this surface: chat live-push moved to SSE (issues #92/#93) and socket.io is now kept for voice and video only, neither of which the Go stack implements (internal/api/socketio/server.go still has zero callers). There are no rooms on the SSE transport, so "rooms are rejoined" cannot be delivered or observed. Recorded as a waiver rather than by editing the acceptance text, which uictl holds immutable against the git baseline.
waiver.replacesBehaviour: Live-push stream drop and automatic reconnect over SSE: GIVEN the sidebar subscribes to GET /api/v2/notifications/events/prompt_lib/{projectID}, WHEN the connection is dropped at the transport level, THEN the browser re-opens the stream on its own (EventSource retry, no reload and no application code) AND the re-opened stream is a real text/event-stream from elitea-main that replays its notifications_ready handshake. Covered by J26.1 and J26.3 in e2e/journeys/chat/chat.attachments.spec.ts; the socket-connection indicator is still asserted there against its real state.

items.title: Route `/shared/chat/:token` is mounted
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /shared/chat/:token
THEN the shared read-only conversation for that token is displayed at that URL
AND an unknown or revoked token does not expose any conversation
